hero.title: Build English skills for life and work.
hero.body: MEX helps learners develop practical English communication and career-readiness skills through purposeful learning and real-world practice.
hero.demoNote: This is an early demo, not a finished product. Lessons and practice are still being built.

pathways.label: Two pathways
pathways.title: Two learning pathways, one goal
pathways.intro: MEX is built around two central pathways of equal importance.

generalEnglish.name: General English
generalEnglish.body: Build confidence in everyday communication, useful expressions, listening, and speaking.

careerReadiness.name: Career Readiness
careerReadiness.body: Prepare for interviews, workplace conversations, presentations, and professional communication.

how.title: How MEX works
how.intro: The intended learner journey has three steps.

choose.title: Choose a pathway
choose.body: Start with General English or Career Readiness, depending on what you need now.

practise.title: Practise relevant skills
practise.body: Work through short lessons, exercises and speaking practice built around real situations.

track.title: Track your development
track.body: See which skills you have practised and how your confidence grows over time.

how.note: This is how MEX is designed to work. In the current demo, these steps are still being built.

learners.title: Individual learners
learners.body: Students, jobseekers and working professionals who want practical English for everyday life and for work.

employers.title: Employers
employers.body: Organisations that want candidates and staff to communicate confidently at work. Tools for employers are planned.

institutions.title: Educational institutions
institutions.body: Universities, colleges and training centres that want to add practical English and employability skills to their programmes. Tools for institutions are planned.

status.title: What works today
status.intro: MEX is a prototype in active development. Here is what you can try now and what is still planned.

available.preview: A preview of the app screens and navigation
available.languages: The interface in English, Uzbek and Russian

planned.lessons: Lessons and practice for both pathways

status.plannedNote: Planned features are not available yet and may change.

privacy.title: Your data in this prototype
privacy.body: The demo stores learner progress only on this device, in this browser. Nothing is sent to a server. Clearing your browser data or switching devices means it is lost.
privacy.deleteHint: You can delete your data at any time in Settings.

footer.copyright: © 2026 Alexis Team LLC. MEX — Modern Employability eXperience.
footer.note: Prototype. Not yet a launched product.

language.question: Choose your language
language.hint: You can change it later with the language button at the top.

level.question: How is your English now?
level.note: Your own estimate. This is not a test.

beginner.name: Beginner
beginner.description: I know a few words and simple phrases.

elementary.name: Elementary
elementary.description: I can have a simple conversation about everyday topics.

intermediate.name: Intermediate
intermediate.description: I can talk about my work, studies and plans, with some mistakes.

goals.question: What do you want English for?

pathway.question: Where would you like to start?
pathway.hint: You can switch pathways at any time.

errors.chooseOne: Please choose one option to continue.
errors.chooseGoal: Please choose at least one goal to continue.

onboarding.storageNotice: Your progress can’t be saved on this device right now (for example, in a private window). You can keep learning, but your progress will be lost when you close MEX.

mission.title: Today's mission
mission.whyBody: MEX chooses missions with fixed rules, the same for every learner. No AI is used.
mission.whyNextUnit: {{activity}}: you finished Unit {{finished}}, so this starts Unit {{unit}}.
mission.whyInterview: {{activity}}: you have not done interview practice in the last 7 days.
mission.whyRepeat: {{activity}}: you have finished everything, and this is where your exercise score is lowest ({{right}} of {{total}} right).
mission.noPlayer: Activities open in a later version of the demo.

readiness.title: Current readiness
readiness.label: Self-assessment
readiness.careerEmpty: Finish interview practice sessions in Career Readiness to build your level. This is your own view, not a test result.
readiness.generalEnglish: Readiness is part of the {{career}} pathway. Your {{general}} progress does not count towards it.
readiness.based: Based on your finished interview practice sessions: {{n}}. This is your own view, not a test result.

pathway.title: Current pathway
pathway.confirm: Switch to {{pathway}}? Your progress in both pathways is kept.

learn.intro: Choose a pathway to see its units and activities.

lesson.toggleHint: Shows a translation of the instructions, notes and grammar explanations.

exercise.toggleHint: Shows a translation of the instructions and explanations.
exercise.practiceNote: This is practice. It does not change your readiness.

listening.noVoice: This device has no English voice that works offline, so the text is shown instead.

speaking.recordingNote: Your recording stays on this device and is deleted when you leave this page.
speaking.unavailable: Recording isn't available here. You can still practise by speaking aloud.
speaking.selfNote: You check this yourself. MEX does not listen to or score your speaking.

interview.savedNote: Your typed answer is saved only on this device. You can delete it in Settings.
interview.selfNote: You check this yourself. MEX does not read, listen to or score your answers.
interview.confidence: How ready do you feel to answer this in a real interview?

summary.lessonRecap: You worked through the key phrases, grammar and dialogue.
summary.selfCheckRecap: You ticked {{n}} of {{total}} checks. This is your own view, not a test result.
summary.useful: Was this activity useful to you?
summary.thanks: Thanks. Your rating is saved only on this device.

progress.intro: Your progress has three parts. Each one is shown on its own and never added together.

curriculum.title: What you have finished
curriculum.body: Activities and units you have completed in each pathway.

skills.title: What you got right
skills.body: Your answers in checked exercises in both pathways, by skill. If you answer a question again, your latest answer counts.

readiness.how: Your level is based on how many interview practice sessions you have finished and, in your 3 most recent sessions, how confident you felt and how many self-check boxes you ticked.
readiness.ownView: This is your own view, not a test result.
readiness.confidence: Average confidence in your recent sessions: {{value}} of 5
readiness.notRated: Average confidence in your recent sessions: not rated yet
readiness.ticked: Self-check boxes ticked in your recent sessions: {{ticked}} of {{boxes}}
readiness.speaking: Speaking practice in Career Readiness: {{n}} done
readiness.speakingNote: Speaking practice is shown as supporting evidence. It does not change your level.

stub.comingSoon: This screen is coming in a later task.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The link may be wrong or out of date.

settings.deleteConfirmBody: This removes your profile, progress and practice records from this device. It cannot be undone.
settings.privacyNote: MEX keeps your progress only on this device. Nothing is sent to a server.
